definition.en: The direction in which most fibres of a machine-made paper lie (the machine direction). Paper folds more cleanly, curls and expands less, and is stiffer in bending along it; a sheet document records it per sheet as grain_deg.
definition.es: La dirección en que se alinea la mayoría de las fibras de un papel hecho a máquina (la dirección de máquina). A lo largo de ella el papel dobla más limpio, se ondula y se dilata menos, y es más rígido a la flexión; un documento de pliego la registra por pliego como grain_deg.
definition.fr: La direction dans laquelle s'alignent la plupart des fibres d'un papier fabriqué à la machine (le sens machine). Le long de cette direction, le papier se plie plus net, gondole et se dilate moins, et résiste mieux à la flexion ; un document de feuille l'enregistre par feuille sous grain_deg.
definition.pt: A direção em que se alinha a maioria das fibras de um papel feito à máquina (a direção de máquina). Ao longo dela o papel dobra de forma mais limpa, ondula e dilata menos, e é mais rígido à flexão; um documento de folha regista-a por folha como grain_deg.

aliases.name: grain_deg
aliases.note: pliego:sheets[].grain_deg: the machine direction in sheet-local coordinates, degrees counter-clockwise from +u, default 90.

constraints: Bending stiffness differs by roughly a factor of two between machine and cross direction (D_md vs D_cd); a pop-up or book whose folds run across the grain needs scoring, and a book's grain should run parallel to its spine.
sources: Pliego docs/spec/v1/sheet-document.md §5.1-§5.2 — grain_deg and the MD/CD stiffness pair
Pliego docs/spec/v1/stock-card.md — MD/CD ratio basis (Baum et al. 1981)

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass with the sheet commons (keystone lane, 2026-10-10); no native review yet. es is the house register; fr and pt want a native pass.

notes: Not the textile grainline: the cloth's grainline (fashion-cabinet) and the paper's grain are both fibre directions, but paper has no bias stretch to exploit and its grain is fixed at the mill, not chosen on the marker.
